description: Na₅Li₃Ti₂S₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiS₆ octahedra, corners with five NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TiS₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one LiS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent TiS₄ tetrahedra, and  a faceface with one LiS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-58°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.80-3.20 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent TiS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent LiS₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent TiS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-58°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.78-3.01 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.36 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four S atoms to form LiS₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiS₆ octahedra, corners with five NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TiS₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one LiS₆ octahedra, edges with two NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one TiS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-69°. There are a spread of Li-S bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.51 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted LiS₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent TiS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent TiS₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-54°. There are a spread of Li-S bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.91 Å. Ti is bonded to four S atoms to form TiS₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiS₆ octahedra, corners with three NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one LiS₆ octahedra, edges with three NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-65°. There are a spread of Ti-S bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.29 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na, two Li, and one Ti atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Li, and one Ti atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to three Na, two Li, and one Ti atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Li, and one Ti atom.
